# Saga Telecom

> Saga Telecom is an engineering and supply-chain-first telecom partner based in Shenzhen, China.
> We concentrate on managed switching built on Marvell and CENTEC chipset platforms, provide deep OEM/ODM/SKD/CKD customization, and hold strategic chip inventory so supply holds when allocation tightens.
> We serve OEMs, brand owners, system integrators, ISPs, and distributors who value architectural consistency, lifecycle continuity, and low total deployment cost.

## What we do

- Access-layer managed switching on Marvell platforms (L2+, PoE / PoE+ / PoE++, ERPS G.8032 ring protection)
- Aggregation, core, and data-center switching on CENTEC platforms (L3, EVPN-VXLAN, MLAG, MPLS, 10G to 100G)
- Commercial and industrial Ethernet switches, DIN-rail and rack-mount
- OEM / ODM / SKD / CKD customization: hardware, firmware, CLI, SNMP MIBs, and web UI white-labeling
- Strategic chip inventory and lifecycle management for predictable supply

## Selected products

- STI-488XGGPM2B-2BT — 8-port industrial L2+ managed PoE++ switch with fiber bypass and 10G uplinks
- STC-424XGGPM-280W — 24-port commercial L2+ managed PoE switch with 4x10G SFP+ and redundant AC
- STH-2C12XF12XE-HSI — half-width L3 managed switch with 10G access and 100G uplinks
- STI-21616GP — 16-port industrial PoE+ unmanaged switch, 240W budget, DIN-rail, for outdoor CCTV
- STC-448XGGM — 48-port commercial L3 managed switch with 4x10G SFP+ uplinks and AC/DC options
- STH-8C48DX-HSI — data-center L3 switch with 48x25G SFP28 and 8x100G uplinks, redundant hot-swap PSU

## Why Saga Telecom

- Engineering-driven, not marketing-driven: we optimize feature sets, hold strategic inventory, deliver deep customization.
- Strategic inventory is the product — buffer stock on key chipsets planned against demand, not speculative stockpiling.
- Lifecycle continuity — hardware, firmware, and software stay coherent across product generations.
- Transparent boundaries: we do not do cloud-managed platforms, rail/transit certified switches, IP67 enclosures, or consumer routers.
